# A&L Stump Grinding

> A&L Stump Grinding is a veteran-owned and operated residential stump grinding company serving the Greater Atlanta, Georgia area. We grind stumps of every size, handle tight backyard access other equipment can't reach, and leave the site cleaned up and graded. Free estimates, 10+ years serving north Georgia.
